PHASE.NAME: RTK Rewrite Hook Delegation
PHASE.GOAL: Move hook command rewrite decisions into the Synapse binary so OpenCode plugin and shell hooks delegate to one router-backed source of truth.

STEPS.step-1: Expose syn rewrite as a hook-facing dry-run command.
STEPS.step-2: Implement router-backed rewrite decisions and shell-safe multi-arg output.
STEPS.step-3: Dispatch RewriteCmd through the binary entry point.
STEPS.step-4: Generate OpenCode shell hooks that delegate command decisions to syn rewrite.
STEPS.step-5: Update standalone OpenCode rewrite hook to delegate to syn rewrite.
STEPS.step-6: Document rewrite and RTK shortcuts as shipped CLI capabilities.
STEPS.step-7: Verify syn rewrite routeable and unsupported command behavior.
STEPS.step-8: Allow shipped grep shortcut in public-doc parity checks.
